title: Vintage J.C. Penney Porcelain Doll Lot #5652 with Box - New
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: A vintage J.C. Penney collectible porcelain doll lot #5652 with box is being offered. The doll is a 16-inch Caucasian girl doll made of porcelain. It is a set that includes the doll in its original opened packaging. The doll is from the 1980s and was manufactured in Taiwan. The lot consists of multiple dolls with similar characteristics.
